regions.description: AWS regions whose EventBridge control planes are read. Authentication uses the standard AWS SDK credential chain and is never stored in the manifest or snapshot.

buses.description: Event bus names or ARNs to include. Left out, every bus the current AWS identity can list in the selected regions.

sources.description: Exact EventBridge source values mapped to Portolan service ids, for example {"com.acme.orders": "shop.orders"}. These mappings identify publishers.

targets.description: EventBridge target identifiers mapped to Portolan service ids. A key may be a full ARN, target id, resource name, or service-qualified name such as lambda:invoice-handler. These mappings identify consumers.

ruleTags.description: Optional rule tags that identify the consumer service when a target has no explicit targets mapping. This is suitable for rules whose targets all belong to one service.

context.description: Tag whose value is the bounded context slug.

service.description: Tag whose value is the service slug.

cache.description: Where the last run's eventbridge.json and eventbridge.lock.json were written, repo-relative: the same path as the step's out. Offline and failed API runs replay this checked snapshot.
